title: Screechia's Egg Heist
story: Screechia the Harpy has stolen dragon eggs from the friendly dragons of Ember Cliff and hidden them in her nests! Mr 6 climbs up and finds 3 nests, and each nest holds 4 warm dragon eggs.
question: How many dragon eggs must Mr 6 carry home?
hint: Add 4 three times: 4 + 4 + 4. That's the same as 3 groups of 4!
victory: With all 12 eggs tucked safely in his cloak, Mr 6 climbs down as Screechia shrieks in defeat. The mother dragons are so grateful they light the village lanterns every night from then on!
